wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/obj/fix_pinned_seek_test.py: """This test asserted elephc's answer, not php's.

MEASURED on `php -n` 8.5.6, running the test's OWN program unchanged:

    Warning: fseek(): SeekW::stream_tell is not implemented!
    -1|
    Warning: fseek(): SeekW::stream_tell is not implemented!
    -1

`SeekW` defines `stream_seek` and no `stream_tell`, and php reconciles its own position after every
successful seek by calling `stream_tell` — so the seek is refused. The test pinned `0|0`, which is
what elephc used to answer.

The test keeps its subject — that `fseek()` reaches `stream_seek` — and gains the half it was
missing: reaching
